title: The Fantasy Draft: Turn Your Top Picks Into Football Grails
summary: Celebrate fantasy draft week with 25 player bounties and boosted buyback offers.
body_markdown:
*TL;DR - Three Fantasy Draft Football packs drop this week, featuring 25 bounty cards tied to top fantasy picks. Pull one and keep it vaulted through the event to earn 40,000 Courtyard Points.*
Fantasy football draft week is one of the best parts of the season. Everyone has a[sleeper they’re convinced will break out](https://courtyard.io/blog/post/nfl-card-watch-fantasy-football-draft-picks-for-2026-and-their-cardboard-counterparts) , a star they refuse to leave the first round without, and at least one pick they’ll spend the next four months defending.


This year, we wanted to give football fans another way to celebrate their favorite picks.


Enter[The Fantasy Draft](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=limited_drop) : a three-day run of limited Football packs on[Courtyard](https://courtyard.io/) built around 25 of the most sought-after players on fantasy draft boards. Pull the exact bounty card tied to one of those 25 players, hold it in your Courtyard collection through the end of the event, and you’ll earn **40,000 Courtyard Points.** You keep the card, too.


## **Three Days. Three Rounds.**


A new[Fantasy Draft pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=limited_drop) drops each day from Tuesday through Thursday, with 25 total bounty cards and plenty of other chases spread across the three rounds:


- **Round 1:** Tuesday, September 1
- **Round 2:** Wednesday, September 2
- **Round 3 (Spicy):** Thursday, September 3


Every card pulled from these packs also comes with a **+5% boosted buyback offer** , giving you more value if you decide to take the instead offer.


Just remember: if you pull one of the 25 bounty cards, it must remain in your collection through **September 7 at 12AM UTC** to qualify for the 40,000-point reward. Each pack features football cards from across the league, but only the 25 exact cards on the official bounty list qualify for the points reward.


## **A Few Bounty Board Highlights**


###### **Justin Jefferson 2019 Select XRC Tie-Dye, PSA 10**


Justin Jefferson is already the kind of player fantasy managers build an entire roster around. His bounty card is just as much of a centerpiece: a 2019 Select XRC Tie-Dye graded PSA 10 and valued at **$1,949** .


###### **Garrett Wilson 2022 Contenders Cracked Ice Autograph, PSA 9**


Few card types pair a young star and a rookie-year chase as cleanly as a Cracked Ice autograph. This 2022 Contenders Garrett Wilson auto is graded PSA 9 and valued at **$1,220** , making it another one of the biggest bounties on the board.


###### **Jahmyr Gibbs 2023 Mosaic Micro Mosaic, PSA 10**


The projected first pick on the fantasy board comes with one of the event’s best modern case hits. The 2023 Mosaic Micro Mosaic Jahmyr Gibbs is graded PSA 10 and valued at **$530** . Pulling the top fantasy pick and another 40,000 points feels like a strong start to any draft.


## **Draft Your Team. Build Your Collection.**


Fantasy rosters change every season. The right football card can stay in your collection for a lot longer.


Whether you’re chasing the player you took first overall, a hometown favorite, or the breakout pick you believe everyone else is overlooking, The Fantasy Draft gives you plenty of chances to turn that conviction into something you can actually collect.


Good luck in both drafts.
